combatants.name: Manifestation of Durmor
combatants.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: The manifestation can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone, leaving a glowing seam of cooling rock behind it.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The manifestation sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Molten Body
traits.description: A creature that touches the manifestation or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) Fire damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The manifestation deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.description: The manifestation takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet it moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it, and its AC drops by 2 until the end of its next turn as its crust cracks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manifestation makes two attacks, using Molten Slam or Lava Lob in any combination.
actions.attacks_text: two attacks, using Molten Slam or Lava Lob in any combination

actions.name: Molten Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Lava Lob
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
actions.additional_ruling: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Eruption (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the manifestation. Failure: 16 (3d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. The ground in the Emanation becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of the manifestation's next turn.
actions.target: each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the manifestation
actions.extra_ruling: The ground in the Emanation becomes Difficult Terrain until the end of the manifestation's next turn.
